sources.use: Dark Sphere mana cost per rank; rank 5 = 60 mana. Cooldown 7 s at every rank.
The only other Syndra ability that can cost 100 mana (rank 5). Its shortest cooldown (8 s at rank 5) is strictly longer than Q's 7 s.

sources.use: Completes the Syndra cost table: {Q: 40/45/50/55/60, W: 60/70/80/90/100, E: 50, R: 100}. 60 mana can only be Q(r5) or W(r1); 100 mana can only be W(r5) or R.

sources.quote: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2."
sources.use: At the scenario's 120 splinters (the '120' in the scenario id, and the Transcendence cap per Syndra.P: 'stacking up to 120 times' / 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence'), Dark Sphere is a 2-charge ability, so the opening rotation contains TWO Dark Sphere casts, each paying full mana.

sources.use: Confirms the second Dark Sphere charge is a stocked *cast* (ammo), not a free recast: each stocked cast is an independent Dark Sphere cast and pays Dark Sphere's mana cost.

sources.quote: modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] ... "ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)" ... "splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge"

sources.path: Section 1.1 + audit table row 'Ability rotation casts'
sources.quote: "Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline ... an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order"; "R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)"
sources.use: Gives the ordering rule used to identify which ability occupies cast_timeline[5]: opening casts first (greedy by cast order), then recasts in cooldown order; R never recasts.

sources.quote: "Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste" — Ability Haste 10/20/30
sources.use: Only shortens Q further (7 x 100/(100+30) = 5.38 s at R rank 3), reinforcing that the first recast on the shared timeline is a Dark Sphere.

computation.step_1_cost_table: From the cached wiki rows, Syndra's mana costs are Q 40/45/50/55/60, W 60/70/80/90/100, E 50 flat, R 100 flat. So a 60-mana cast is either Q at rank 5 or W at rank 1; a 100-mana cast is either W at rank 5 or R.
computation.step_2_which_cast_is_index_5: cast_timeline[5] is the 6th cast. At 120 splinters Dark Sphere is a 2-charge ability, so the opening (each available cast fired once) is five casts: Q, Q(2nd charge), W, E, R. The 6th cast is therefore the first RECAST, and by the shared-timeline rule ('recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed', math-foundations 1.1) that is the ability with the shortest cooldown. Q = 7 s at every rank (5.38 s with R rank 3's +30 ability haste on Q); W's shortest possible cooldown is 8 s (rank 5) and is 12 s at rank 1; E = 15 s; R is single-cast. min(7, 8, 15) = 7 -> the 6th cast is a Dark Sphere, unconditionally on rank assignment.
computation.step_3_value: A Dark Sphere cast at rank 5 costs 60 mana. (Level-18 max mana = 480 + 40 x 17 x (0.7025 + 0.0175 x 17) = 1160, so no resource clamping is in play; a cost leaf is the sourced cost, not a mana-limited payment.) => cast_timeline[5].resource_cost = 60.0.
computation.step_4_where_100_came_from: 100 mana is reachable at index 5 only if the timeline OMITS the second Dark Sphere charge: a four-cast opening (Q, W, E, R) makes index 4 the Q recast at 7 s and index 5 the W recast at 8 s = 100 mana at W rank 5. That reconstruction contradicts the cached wiki text for the scenario's 120-splinter state, which grants up to 2 stocked Dark Sphere charges; a 120-splinter timeline that fires Dark Sphere only once undercounts casts. Alternatively 100 would be R, but R sits in the opening (index <= 4) and never recasts.
computation.conclusion: 60.0 is the value supported by the cached wiki data; 100.0 is the artifact of a cast timeline that ignores Syndra's stocked second Dark Sphere charge at 40+ splinters.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition itself lives in scripts/ (out of bounds for this runbook), so the ability ranks and the exact cast order were not read; the identification of index 5 relies on the cooldown argument above, which is rank-independent for the ORDERING (Q always recasts first) but assumes Q is at rank 5 for the VALUE. Rank 5 is the only Q rank that yields 60; a lower Q rank would have produced 40/45/50/55, none of which is the observed new value. The observed new value therefore matches Q rank 5 (a level-18 maxed-Q build) exactly.
The one reading under which the old value would be correct — a four-cast opening with W maxed — is exactly the reading the 120-splinter Q-charge wiki text rules out.
